  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Audit Committee</h3><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">NOTE: As of 8 June 2013 Audit Committee Meetings will be arranged as required by the CEO in consultation with the Chairperson.</p><h3 style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Special Meetings Of Council</h3><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Where practical, prior public notice will be given of the time, date and place of any Special Meetings of Council open to the public.</p><h3 style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Agendas</h3><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Ordinary Council Meetings are open to the Public. Public copies of Agendas may be obtained at the Administration Office and are generally available from noon on the Tuesday prior to the meeting date. Agendas are available at www.mtmagnet.wa.gov.au from noon on the Tuesday prior to the meeting.</p><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><h3 style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Public Question Time</h3><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Public Question Time provides an opportunity for residents to ask a question of Council at any Ordinary Meeting, Special Meeting, Electors Meeting or Committee Meeting. Although not a requirement of the Local Government Act 1995 or Council’s Standing Orders, your assistance with putting your question to Council in writing will assist with providing responses at the meeting and accurate minute-taking.</p><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><br>Please <a target="_blank" href="https://www.mtmagnet.wa.gov.au/document-centre">click here</a> to download the Public Question Time template and guidance notes. If you are able to complete this form and provide advance notice of the question(s) you intend to raise at a Committee or Council meeting, officers will try to ensure that a full and detailed response is provided to you at the meeting.</p><p class="" style="text-align: justify; white-space: pre-wrap" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><br>The completed form can be returned to Council, either by:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Hand delivering it to the Councils Administration Office, 90 Hepburn Street Mount Magnet; or</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Emailing it to <a href="mailto:shire@mtmagnet.wa.gov.au">ea@mtmagnet.wa.gov.au</a> </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The completed form should be addressed to the CEO.</p></li></ul></div>
